title: Trump’s deportations to third countries violate human rights, UN experts warn
summary_full: Sending migrants to countries they do not come from can have deadly consequences and must be halted, says reportThe deportation of thousands of migrants from the US to third countries has set off a “cascade of human rights violations” that could have “deadly” consequences, two dozen UN human rights experts have warned.Since Donald Trump returned to power in 2025, the US government has been offering millions of dollars to foreign governments to take in migrants, including refugees and asylum seekers, with no ties to their countries. Deals have been struck with 35 nations, nearly a third of them in Africa. Continue reading...
